statement: A separate linux.uinput instance per half is the lowest-risk first playable realization for the pinned Linux evdev subset. Faithful recognition as Switch 2 Joy-Con USB needs composite USB transport with vendor-class bulk configuration and HID interfaces; the current fixed HID dummy_hcd, HID-only UHID and USB-audio USB/IP provider shapes are not evidence that this native topology is available. This is an architectural inference, not a measured provider acceptance result.

applicability.scope: Implementation planning: playable first, native USB later
